policy.comparisonRule: Never average event times from different definitions, locations, coordinate frames, or visibility models.
policy.unknownValues: Keep null or omit; never fill by inference.
policy.locationComparison: Every benchmark case is scoped to one named source location. Never compare or average across locations. If the provider's exact observer coordinates are undisclosed, label the case city-level-only and do not claim coordinate-exact validation.
